statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); agent=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.agent.name // empty'); session_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); it=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.input_tokens // 0'); ot=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.output_tokens // 0'); cc=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0'); cr=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.cache_read_input_tokens // 0'); ws=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // 0'); cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null; branch=$(git -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'no git'); short_dir=$(echo "$cwd" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|" | awk -F/ '{if (NF>3) print "..."$(NF-1)"/"$NF; else print $0}'); session_info=''; [ -n "$session_id" ] && session_info=" | ${session_id}"; context_info=''; if [ "$ws" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then total=$((it + ot + cc + cr)); pct=$((total * 100 / ws)); ws_k=$((ws / 1000)); context_info=" | ctx: ${pct}% / ${ws_k}k"; fi; model_info=''; if [ -n "$agent" ]; then model_info="$agent"; elif [ -n "$model" ]; then model_info="$model"; fi; printf "%s | %s%s%s | %s" "$short_dir" "$branch" "$session_info" "$context_info" "$model_info"

soft_deny: Writing a whole file from Bash: a heredoc redirected into a file (cat > path <<EOF, tee path <<EOF) or a script calling File.write/IO.write. Use Write for a whole file, Edit for part of one — Edit anchors on exact text and fails loudly instead of leaving a half-rewritten file. Bulk find-and-replace (sed -i, perl -pi) and redirection into new output are fine, as is anything under ./tmp (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
Bash(python:*), Bash(python3:*), Bash(pip:*) — scripts are Ruby here; use ruby -e, jq, or shell tools (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
Writing scratch to /tmp — use ./tmp so scratch stays visible in the workspace; the per-session scratchpad under /tmp/claude-* is exempt (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
hard_deny: Bash(git push:*) — pushing is the user's alone, including after an auth problem clears; committing locally is fine (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
Any git commit whose message carries a Co-Authored-By trailer — commits land under the user's authorship only, even when a harness attribution reminder asks for the trailer (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
